posts.text: Dominica: USD 200,000 to the Economic Diversification Fund. Antigua and Barbuda: USD 230,000 to the National Development Fund. Both use agent-submitted applications; these are contributions, not property purchases.
posts.alt: Dominica and Antigua and Barbuda. Actual local citizenship-directory excerpt with separately authored official-source conditions and fee comparisons. One main applicant · Published currencies · Fees extra; Dominica; Non-refundable EDF contribution. Authorised agent submits.; Antigua and Barbuda; NDF contribution. Licensed local agent submits. posts.text: Grenada: USD 235,000 to the National Transformation Fund. Saint Lucia: USD 240,000 to the National Economic Fund, plus a sworn declaration of at least USD 350,000 in financial resources.
posts.alt: Contribution versus financial resources. Actual local citizenship-directory excerpt with separately authored official-source conditions and fee comparisons. One main applicant · Published currencies · Fees extra; Grenada; NTF contribution; payment follows approval.; Saint Lucia; Sworn declaration: at least USD 350,000 financial resources. This is not another payment. Screenshot text: From USD 235,000 Contribution; From USD 240,000 Contribution

posts.text: Saint Kitts and Nevis: USD 250,000 Sustainable Island State Contribution. Turkiye: USD 400,000 qualifying real estate, with a 3-year resale restriction and a presidential citizenship decision.
posts.alt: A contribution or a property purchase. Actual local citizenship-directory excerpt with separately authored official-source conditions and fee comparisons. One main applicant · Published currencies · Fees extra; Saint Kitts and Nevis; Sustainable Island State Contribution. Main-applicant interview required.; Turkiye; Qualifying property. At least 3-year resale restriction; subject to presidential decision. Screenshot text: From USD 250,000 Contribution; From USD 400,000 Property

posts.text: Sao Tome and Principe: USD 90,000 National Transformation Fund donation. Nauru: USD 115,000 regular Treasury contribution; USD 90,000 offer for applications filed before December 31, 2026. Both add fees.

posts.text:
Egypt: USD 250,000 Treasury grant. Jordan, outside Capital Governorate: your eligible asset share must average at least JOD 350,000 over 3 audited years, with 10 Jordanian employees on average and at least 9 each month.
